summary_1line: Hanuman pauses his search and closely observes Ravana’s magnificent aerial chariot Pushpaka, marveling at its divine craftsmanship and supernatural powers.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands in the golden halls of Lanka gazing up at the radiant Pushpaka chariot, glittering with gems and flowers like a mountain of light.
The celestial Pushpaka chariot, plated with gold and studded with jewels, hovers in the sky carried by thousands of fierce demons with wide unblinking eyes.
Pushpaka shines like the autumn moon in the night sky, its many ornate chambers and artworks glowing as it travels through the firmament.
